headline: Frontier Posts Shift Amid Renewed Action
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the sharpest movement is on Nevish Line: holdings now stand at four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld, against the earlier six-to-two division. Seven event rows have appeared there in the last two hours, the latest at 14:51 UTC. Linn’s Mercy has also shifted from ten Colonial bases and one unheld to eight Colonial, two Warden and one unheld, with five event rows in two hours and 13 in six. Stonecradle reports six rows in that same short span, though eight of its nine bases remain Colonial-held and one Warden-held. Weathered Expanse, Marban Hollow and Mooring County retain their previous ownership divisions; none has logged an event in the last two hours, though each saw substantial activity earlier in the day. Callahan’s Passage records the heaviest continuing casualty traffic, with losses accelerating on both sides, but no strategic-base event is logged there. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required. Loss and capture rows may describe one transfer rather than separate engagements.
